criteria.rule: All ten motions produce the named artifact and human gate in the exact catalog order. Market Intel and Segment are separate; Persona is not replaced by a stakeholder map; opportunities are needs in the tree; Storyboard precedes Minimum Viable Narrative. No agent-strategy or added learning-review stage.

Only actual prior handoff content crosses stages. Selected segment survives into Persona; actual persona into the tree; actual selected opportunity and concept into 2x2; separate proposed value/difference and comparator into Positioning; selected statement into Hypothesis; actual hypothesis and prewritten rule into Storyboard; actual six frames into MVN; full narrative and rule into Prototyping. Any dropped required artifact is a chain failure even if honestly flagged. Missing context cannot be invented.

No actual interviews, plant observations, source URLs, market figures, measured benefits or willingness to pay fabricated. Synthetic status and UNKNOWN quantities survive; fictional examples and 2x2 placements are not validated customer evidence.
No selected segment, concept or human approval invented before a participant reply. Later choices are scripted teaching choices; no silent next-stage invocation.
Prototyping reports NOT BUILT and participant experiment NOT RUN. It compares cheaper methods and cannot claim product or operational validation.
